name: TVL inflow + macro risk-on — defi_tvl cross-up gated by macro_regime arms an alt-momentum long
rationale: Thesis: DeFi capital inflows (defi_tvl cross_up) extend alt-L1 trends most reliably when the broad macro backdrop is risk-on — in a risk-off macro, on-chain inflows are often short-lived rotations that fade. macro_regime is a BOUNDED composite, so a fitted floor binds and we require it above a risk-on threshold. defi_tvl drifts, so it enters ONLY as a cross_up; positive own-momentum confirms direction. Disconfirmer 1: drop the macro_regime gate — if the deflated Sharpe is unchanged, the macro arm never bound and we should not claim a macro-conditioned edge. Disconfirmer 2: drop the defi_tvl cross_up and keep macro-gate + momentum — if the Sharpe holds, TVL adds no orthogonal information. ETH/SOL/AVAX/BNB/LINK, long-only spot.
catalyst: defi_tvl crosses up while macro_regime is risk-on and alt momentum is positive
